messages:
deploy-bot: starting prod deploy to us-east-1 (rolling across 3 azs). image: rev-2026-03-15, target: service/orch (replicas=24). commit: c0ffee1234b7a9d0e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f234567890 by Liam Nguyen. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/pull/4521
priya: @deploy-bot any change-window note? this came in after the >24h freeze cutoff? :thinking_face:
sam: priya good catch — change window was 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight per release calendar. this is inside window so ok.
liam: quick summary: fixes routing fallback for multi-model routing + perf tweak to batching logic. tested in staging (canary 5% for 2h, no errors).
carla: pinging monitoring/ops — readiness hooks and latency dashboards please watch next 30m. also request we pin the rollback candidate SHA in the message (so ops can roll fast).
release-coordinator-bot: rollback-candidate: 9b8a7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b (tag: rev-2026-03-14). change-window: 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z-2026-03-15T04:00:00Z. SLA-impact: low.
priya: ack. @liam can you confirm the rollback contains the prior verified model-routing commit? i.e. run `git show --no-patch --format=\"%h %s\" 9b8a7c6` and paste output.
liam: sure, pasting:`
```
9b8a7c6  revert: restore stable routing for v1 models (tested)
```
liam: that's the one. priya we good to proceed with canary ramp to 20% then 100% if no regressions.
sam: canary started (20%) — logs: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/orch -f --since=5m` looks clean, no 500 spikes.
carla: seeing slight latency uptick on endpoints /generate (p50 +12ms) but within SLO. continuing watch.
deploy-bot: canary health: OK. rolling to 100% now. details: https://deploys.redwood.com/orch/1764500123
release-coordinator-bot: note: pin requested by carla. pinned-rollback: 9b8a7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b (owner: ops-oncall).
priya: thanks all. reminder to add the short release note blurb to release-notes/2026-03-15.md: \"orch: routing fallback fix + batching perf; rolled to prod 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC; rollback candidate pinned.\"
liam: done, added PR comment and release note.
carla: deploy finished — no errors, key metrics stable. closing thread. :tada:
deploy-bot: deploy finished for orch (prod, us-east-1) — final sha: c0ffee1234b7a9d0e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f234567890. duration: 11m 26s. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.com/orch/rev-2026-03-15
